get.description: Redirect the user here to begin the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. After the user logs in and approves your application, they are redirected to your `redirect_uri` with a `code` parameter.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: Absolute HTTPS URI that must start with the Callback Prefix registered for your application.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional opaque value preserved through the redirect for CSRF protection.

302.description: Redirect to `redirect_uri?code=CODE` on user approval, or an error page on failure.
